models_evaluated: six LLMs (domain-specific medical and general-purpose; individual names not reported in text)

links.outcome: LLM performance on clinical safety and effectiveness benchmark, including high-risk scenarios
links.effect: Average total score 57.2%, safety 54.7%, effectiveness 62.3%; 13.3% performance drop in high-risk scenarios (p < 0.0001).
links.quote: Benchmark testing of six LLMs revealed moderate overall performance (average total score 57.2%, safety 54.7%, effectiveness 62.3%), with a significant 13.3% performance drop in high-risk scenarios (p < 0.0001).

screen.reason: The paper introduces and tests an evaluation benchmark (CSEDB) measuring clinical safety and effectiveness metrics across six LLMs using physician-developed questions.
